in_sanskrit.name: Gobinda
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: He who delights the Lord Govinda with his mind, words and deeds

in_marathi.name: Gobinda
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Fortune, Pleasure
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gobinda हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gobinda is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'go-binda', which means 'to bind or tie to the Lord'. In Hindu mythology, Gobinda is often identified with Lord Krishna and is known as the god of fortune and pleasure. He is also considered a protector and a giver of boons.
